Cool daylight illuminates a remote science-fiction power installation scene. The front remains open. A broad, clear approach crosses dark metallic ground toward a tall central tower. Two smaller towers stand behind this tower, while low, uneven mounds line the rear and both sides of the site. The central tower remains the dominant landmark. To the right of the central tower, generators form a compact group. Curved metal pipes run between these generators and the base of the central tower, and additional pipe sections gather beside the generators. Behind the generator group stand power-line units, with cords lying near their bases. To the left of the approach, a metal statue stands apart from the machinery. The ground and equipment have weathered metallic surfaces with restrained glowing accents. The smaller towers, mounds, and grouped machinery frame the open approach. A clear route leads from the front to the central tower.
